data.long_description:
Discover this spacious and well-maintained studio apartment for rent in Oxford Residence 2, one of the most sought-after residential developments in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). Offering a generous layout, modern finishes, and a prime location, this apartment is perfect for individuals or couples looking for a comfortable home in a vibrant community.

Property Features:

⦁ Spacious studio layout
⦁ Ready to move in
⦁ Chiller free
⦁ Flexible cheque options
⦁ Modern kitchen
⦁ Built-in wardrobes
⦁ High-quality finishes
⦁ Covered parking
⦁ Central air conditioning

The apartment is ready to move in, allowing you to settle into your new home immediately without any waiting period. Designed with functionality and comfort in mind, the studio features a spacious open-plan layout that provides ample room for both living and sleeping areas. Large windows bring in abundant natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere throughout the day.

The modern kitchen comes with high-quality cabinetry and plenty of storage space, while the contemporary bathroom is finished with premium fittings. The apartment also includes built-in wardrobes, maximizing storage while maintaining a clean and open feel.

One of the biggest advantages of this property is that it is chiller free, helping tenants reduce monthly utility expenses and enjoy greater value throughout the year. The landlord also offers flexible cheque options, making it easier to find a payment plan that suits your financial needs.
